glosses: An Aramean.
A subfamily of languages in the Northwest Semitic language group, including, but not limited to:
The language of the Arameans from the tenth century BC: often called Old Aramaic.
A subfamily of languages in the Northwest Semitic language group, including, but not limited to:

A subfamily of languages in the Northwest Semitic language group, including, but not limited to:
